negative_findings.description: No Montenegrin media outlet was found that maintains a structured, recurring data product (dashboard, downloadable table, standing series page) on cards/ATMs/POS. Every local-media figure encountered was embedded in prose inside a one-off article.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches across bankar.me, cdm.me, rtcg.me, mina.news, gradski.me returned only narrative articles; no media-run dataset or data-journalism section surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be NLP/figure-extraction over article text, not table scraping; expect high extraction cost and mandatory reconciliation against CBCG.

negative_findings.description: The daily 'Dan' did not appear in any search result set despite being explicitly named in the coverage cell; its site was not returned even on a domain-scoped query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query '"cdm.me" ekonomija OR "dan.co.me" ekonomija ...' returned only cdm.me results. dan.co.me is recorded from prior knowledge, not from an observed result, and is flagged unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Dan's URL and its economy-section path must be confirmed by the deterministic liveness pass before any crawler is pointed at it; a wrong domain would silently produce zero coverage of one of the three national dailies.

negative_findings.description: Exact economy-section paths for vijesti.me and pobjeda.me were not surfaced by search; only the site roots and third-party ownership profiles were returned.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither a vijesti.me/ekonomija nor a pobjeda.me/ekonomija URL appeared in any result; searches surfaced Croatian/Bosnian outlets and Media Ownership Monitor profiles instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Seed URLs for the two most important dailies are at root level only, so the collector needs a discovery step (sitemap or on-site navigation) rather than a hard-coded section path.

negative_findings.description: Serbian/Montenegrin payment vocabulary is shared with Croatia, Serbia and Bosnia, so local-language queries pull in HNB, tportal, hrportfolio.hr, biznis.ba and Serbian portals.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'kartično plaćanje gotovina' query returned mostly Croatian and Bosnian outlets plus ECB pages, with only one genuinely Montenegrin hit (rtcg.me, inflacija.me).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated sr-language collection for this cell must be domain-restricted to .me (plus known ME outlets) or it will be dominated by regional noise and produce cross-country contamination of Montenegrin figures.

negative_findings.description: Specific card/cash volumes for 2025 (81.5m card transactions, ~EUR 2bn value, 5.5m cash transactions) were seen in a single local outlet's article summary and are not independently confirmed here.
negative_findings.result_summary: Single-source figure from gradski.me summarising an apparent CBCG-derived dataset; the underlying CBCG release was not located in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Illustrates the core risk of this cell — media figures are second-hand, sometimes rounded or misattributed, and must be reconciled with cbcg.me before entering any analysis.

negative_findings.description: No paywall, archive-pricing or licensing page was located for any of the Montenegrin outlets in this cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access and legal status for vijesti.me, pobjeda.me, dan.co.me, mina.news were inferred, not observed; robots.txt and ToS were not inspected in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Legal/access fields for most candidates in this slice are hypotheses; a compliance check is required before any systematic crawl, especially for the MINA agency wire.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell was scouted at outlet level; individual economy/banking journalists who repeatedly break payment statistics were not identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract bylines from the payment/card articles already found and build a small journalist watchlist (author pages, X/LinkedIn) as a higher-precision monitoring layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Coastal and northern regional outlets and Albanian-language Montenegrin media were not searched; ATM availability and cash dependence are strongly regional (tourism coast vs north).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a scouting pass for regional ME outlets and Albanian-language Montenegrin media (Koha Javore and similar) with sq-language terms for ATM/card/cash.

coverage_gaps.description: Media coverage is driven by bank PR (CKB, NLB, Erste, Lovcen, Hipotekarna, Prva banka). Their own newsroom/press pages, the origin of many quoted ATM/POS counts, were not enumerated in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout each licensed Montenegrin bank's press/news page (list available from CBCG's 'Banke u Crnoj Gori' page) as a companion pointer set to the media cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Only one outlet (Aktuelno.me) exposed a browsable archive index; multi-year back-filling of payment coverage across the main outlets has no established path.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test Wayback Machine CDX coverage for vijesti.me, pobjeda.me and cdm.me economy sections to enable time-series construction of media-reported figures.

brief: Montenegro's payment/card/cash figures reach the public mainly through a short chain: CBCG and MONSTAT releases are picked up by the MINA-Business agency wire, then republished near-verbatim by CdM's economy section and reworked by Vijesti, Pobjeda, RTCG and Bankar.me. CdM, MINA and Bankar.me are the highest-value nodes — CdM for its dense, near-press-release CBCG headline stream, MINA for the earliest timestamp, Bankar.me as the only specialist finance outlet producing its own sector analysis; Gradski.me/PG TV demonstrated that granular card and cash transaction breakdowns do circulate locally in prose form. No Montenegrin outlet publishes a structured dataset, so collection here means figure extraction from article text, always reconciled against cbcg.me. The main practical risks are unresolved seed URLs for Vijesti, Pobjeda and Dan, and heavy cross-border noise from Croatian/Serbian/Bosnian sites on shared Serbian-language payment vocabulary, which makes .me domain restriction mandatory.
